horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: True/false value to determine if the ScrollView is horizontal. If `true`, ScrollView is horizontal, if `false`, it is vertical.

showsHorizontalScrollIndicator.title: Show horizontal scroll indicator
showsHorizontalScrollIndicator.description: True/false value to determine if component should show horizontal scroll indicators.

showsVerticalScrollIndicator.title: Show vertical scroll indicator
showsVerticalScrollIndicator.description: True/false value to determine if component should show vertical scroll indicators.

allowRefresh.title: Refresh enabled (iOS and Android)
allowRefresh.description: True/false value to determine if refreshing should be enabled. Only works in vertical ScrollViews.

contentOffset.title: Starting content offset
contentOffset.description: Number value to determine the content offset at first render of the ScrollView as pixels from the top of vertical ScrollView, and from left of horizontal ScrollView.

scrollEventThrottle.title: Scroll event throttle
scrollEventThrottle.description: Number value to determine how often the scroll event fires as time interval in ms. The default value `0` means onScroll event fires only once per scroll. **Note:** there is a native bug on Android that `0` fires with no interval, so for Android some other interval or a `Throttle` flow function is recommended.

onScroll.title: Scroll event
onScroll.description: Event fired when user scrolls the ScrollView. How often the event fires depends on the `scrollEventThrottle` property, note that Android behaves differently than other platforms.

onMomentumScrollBegin.title: Momentum scroll began (iOS and Android)
onMomentumScrollBegin.description: Called when the momentum scroll starts (scroll which occurs as the ScrollView starts gliding).

onMomentumScrollEnd.title: Momentum scroll ended (iOS and Android)
onMomentumScrollEnd.description: Called when the momentum scroll ends (scroll which occurs as the ScrollView glides to a stop).

onScrollBeginDrag.title: Scroll began drag (iOS and Android)
onScrollBeginDrag.description: Called when the user begins to drag the scroll view.

onScrollEndDrag.title: Scroll drag ended (iOS and Android)
onScrollEndDrag.description: Called when the user stops dragging the scroll view and it either stops or begins to glide.

onRefresh.title: Refresh event (iOS and Android)
onRefresh.description: Event fired when user initiates a refresh event by swiping down when they are at the top of the scroll view. Only applies when ScrollView is horizontal:false and allowRefresh:true.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: True/false value to determine if the input field is disabled. This means the input field can not be typed in.

visible.title: Visibility
visible.description: True/false value to determine if the component is visible.

value.title: Value
value.description:
Current value of the input. 

This is an **Input property**, meaning that any bindings are two-way. For example, if you bind a page variable to this property, changes to the page variable will change the input field's content. Similarly, if the user changes the input field's content, the bound page variable will follow that value.

keyboardType.title: Keyboard type
keyboardType.description: Keyboard type to use on mobile devices.

multiline.title: Multiline input
multiline.description: Allow the input's value to go on multiple lines.

autoCapitalize.title: Auto-capitalize
autoCapitalize.description:
Make the input field automatically capitalize certain characters:

- `none`: no forced capitalization
- `sentences`: sentences are forced to start with a capital letter
- `words`: words are forced to start with a capital letter
- `characters`: every character is forced into a capital letter

autoCorrect.title: Auto-correct
autoCorrect.description: Make the input field automatically correct the user's spelling errors.

secureTextEntry.title: Password input
secureTextEntry.description: True/false value to mask the inputted text by replacing each character with a dot (•), commonly used for password input fields.

blurOnSubmit.title: Blur on submit?
blurOnSubmit.description: True/false value to determine whether or not to blur the input field when user presses enter. Defaults to `true` for a single-line input and `false` for multi-line.

maxLength.title: Max length
maxLength.description: Maximum length for the text input by the user.

returnKeyType.title: Return key type
returnKeyType.description: Defines how the return key should look on Android and iOS. Cross-platform values are `done`, `go`, `next`, `search` and `send`.

selectTextOnFocus.title: Select text on focus
selectTextOnFocus.description: True/false value to determine whether all of the text in the input is selected when user focuses on the input. Works for iOS, Android & Web.

focused.title: Focused
focused.description: Set to true when the input is focused on by the user.

onFocus.title: Input field focused on
onFocus.eventValue: Fires when current input field is focused on.

onBlur.title: Input field blurred
onBlur.eventValue: Fires when current input field loses focus.

onContentSizeChange.title: Input content size changed
onContentSizeChange.eventValue: Content size object containing the new height and width of the input

onSubmitEditing.title: Input content submitted
onSubmitEditing.eventValue: Fires when user pressed submit or enter.

onKeyPress.title: Key pressed
onKeyPress.eventValue: Fires when user presses a key while input field is focused. Contains the information which `key` was pressed.
